name: Venice AI
tagline: Venice is an AI platform built around radical privacy — conversations are processed on-device where possible and never stored, logged, or used for training. It offers uncensored access to open-source models like Llama and Mistral for text, as well as image generation via Flux and Stable Diffusion, without the content restrictions found on mainstream platforms. Journalists, researchers, and privacy-conscious users choose Venice for sensitive queries and creative work that other AI services decline or record.
